name: Meeting Prep
summary: Each weekday morning, a briefing for every meeting: its purpose, what's happened, who's in it, what's owed, what to watch for and the deal in CRM, from your calendar, notes, Echo calls, Teams, mail and CRM

settings.label: Prepare my day each weekday
settings.help: Monday to Friday, at the time below, Claude prepares every meeting of the day (read-only).

settings.label: Prep time
settings.help: When the morning prep is made, as HH:MM in your local time.

settings.label: Send the brief to me in Teams
settings.help: The morning brief also arrives in your Teams chat with yourself.

settings.label: Use Teams, mail and CRM
settings.help: Runs as Claude Code in your Echo folder, so it can use its Microsoft 365 and EPAM CRM connectors (read-only), when Claude Code's settings there allow them. Off: Echo's own data only.

settings.label: Skip internal meetings with nothing on file
settings.help: Leave out internal meetings with no notes, chats or mail about them.

settings.label: Your name
settings.help: How you appear in meetings, for example Alex. Empty: Claude uses the name from your calendar.
